bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for a grant to Enterprise Minnesota, Inc.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; ENTERPRISE MINNESOTA, INC. +]

[+$3,900,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Enterprise Minnesota, Inc. to directly invest in Minnesota manufacturers under the Made in Minnesota program under Minnesota Statutes, section 116O.115, and for operations of Enterprise Minnesota. This appropriation is onetime and is available until June 30, ..... +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for a grant to Enterprise Minnesota, Inc.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; ENTERPRISE MINNESOTA, INC.

$3,900,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Enterprise Minnesota, Inc. to directly invest in Minnesota manufacturers under the Made in Minnesota program under Minnesota Statutes, section 116O.115, and for operations of Enterprise Minnesota. This appropriation is onetime and is available until June 30, .....

This appropriation is onetime and is available until June 30, .....
